verdicts.reason: A looks like a shrunk copy. The headline, chips (tiny 'FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES' text) and CTA are all scaled down and float in the middle, leaving a dead band at the bottom (~120 px below the off-centre partner placeholder). Its sun circle is oversized and crowds the logo. B fills the width better: the headline, date block and chips are larger and more readable, the CTA is bigger and the partner box is centred. But its left-aligned date block (x≈50) does not line up with the centred headline axis or the can graphic, and the bottom 15% is still empty, so it needs polish.
